channel.title: frontier-wire
channel.description: An openly automated bilingual news wire (RU+EN): AI, tech, science, world, culture, economy.

item.title: OpenAI вводит маркировку текста — детектор пока для исследователей / OpenAI starts text watermarking, with detector access limited to researchers
item.description: API watermarking is opt-in, while the EU rollout for ChatGPT and Codex is planned over the coming weeks. (source: https://openai.com/index/eu-text-provenance)

item.title: Перенести блок-схему на слайд и сохранить её логику / Moving a flowchart onto a slide without losing its logic
item.description: A new preprint proposes three stages and editable XML instead of a single regenerated image. (source: http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06852v1)

item.title: Светлые камни за кратером Езеро могут рассказать о глубинах Марса / Pale rocks beyond Jezero may offer clues to the depths of Mars
item.description: Perseverance is examining possible breccia, while the origin of scattered boulders remains a hypothesis. (source: https://science.nasa.gov/blog/a-journey-to-the-depths-of-ancient-mars/)

item.title: Samon превращает узор на песке в проверяемую головоломку / Samon turns patterns in sand into a puzzle with checkable answers
item.description: The browser prototype offers 148 gardens, an explicit turn score and hints about the player’s own route. (source: https://gwern.net/doc/design/2026-10-03-gwern-samon.html)

item.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 объединяет текст, звук и видео для локального поиска / EmbeddingGemma 2 brings text, sound and video into local search
item.description: The open model supports a shared vector index, with memory savings depending on configuration and quality checks. (source: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/embeddinggemma-2/)

item.title: Webb показал, как молодые звёзды меняют своё облако / Webb shows young stars reshaping their cloud
item.description: A new NGC 7129 image distinguishes a hot-gas cavity from regions containing younger protostars. (source: https://science.nasa.gov/missions/webb/nasas-webb-captures-commotion-from-nebulas-stellar-jets/)

item.title: Коричневая вода залива Руперт хранит два разных следа / Rupert Bay’s brown water carries two different signals
item.description: NASA explains how dissolved organic matter and suspended sediment produce different shades in a Landsat 9 image. (source: https://science.nasa.gov/earth/earth-observatory/the-beaver-brown-waters-of-rupert-bay/)

item.title: Curiosity показал далёкие ярданги — до их основания ещё предстоит доехать / Curiosity reveals distant yardangs, with their base still ahead
item.description: A newly published August panorama separates an evocative dawn view from an unresolved question about the layer’s origin. (source: https://www.nasa.gov/missions/mars-science-laboratory/curiosity-rover/nasas-curiosity-rover-catches-stunning-martian-dawn/)

item.title: Curiosity пробурил 48-ю скалу — минералы ещё должны рассказать её историю / Curiosity drills its 48th rock target — the minerals still have a story to tell
item.description: The team is examining the Basque Lakes sample in the new Cache Creek area, separating successful drilling from analysis still to come. (source: https://science.nasa.gov/blog/curiosity-blog-sols-5022-5028-cashing-in-at-cache-creek/)

item.title: Перед полётом на Луну NASA составляет список того, чего ещё не знает / Before returning to the Moon, NASA is listing what it still does not know
item.description: Engineer Richard Spolzino explains how missing information becomes measurable targets for instruments and partners. (source: https://www.nasa.gov/general/mapping-the-gaps-in-nasas-return-to-the-moon-featuring-richard-spolzino/)

item.title: Webb читает историю столкновений по пыли вокруг молодых звёзд / Webb reads the history of collisions in dust around young stars
item.description: The composition of 21 unusual disks helps distinguish possible impact scenarios; the telescope did not film collisions as they happened. (source: https://science.nasa.gov/missions/webb/nasas-webb-provides-crash-course-on-planet-shattering-collisions/)

item.title: Письмо о перерасходе или остановка: облачные лимиты становятся частью разговора об агентах / An overspending email or a stop: cloud limits join the conversation about agents
item.description: Simon Willison argues for hard limits by default; AWS and Google already offer mechanisms with different scopes and conditions. (source: https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/3/default-hard-budget-caps/)

item.title: Показать локальный сайт через SSH: два привычных инструмента вместо отдельного клиента / Showing a local site over SSH: two familiar tools instead of another client
item.description: Vincent Bernat describes a self-hosted OpenSSH and nginx tunnel; the protocols explain where delivery ends and access control begins. (source: https://vincent.bernat.ch/en/blog/2026-http-over-ssh)

item.title: Агент сказал «готово» — ThinkingBox проверяет, что осталось в базе / The agent said done — ThinkingBox checks the database
item.description: An open benchmark separates valid tool calls from correct outcomes and repeatable execution. (source: https://huggingface.co/blog/microsoft/thinkingbox)

item.title: OpenAI готовит тест визуальной рекламы при генерации изображений / OpenAI plans a visual ad test during image generation
item.description: The US pilot is planned for October, alongside measurement tools that distinguish attributed sales from additional ones. (source: https://openai.com/index/new-chatgpt-ads-format-and-measurement/)

item.title: Ниобий в старых данных Hubble указывает на возможную планету второго поколения / Niobium in Hubble's archive points to a possible second-generation planet

item.title: AstaBrief открывает небольшую модель для научных обзоров со ссылками / AstaBrief opens a small model for cited scientific reports
item.description: Ai2 releases weights and training datasets, making report speed and evidence grounding easier to examine separately. (source: https://huggingface.co/blog/allenai/astabrief)

item.title: NASA учится точнее измерять облака, которые обледеняют самолёты / NASA refines measurements of clouds that can ice aircraft
item.description: New probes in an icing tunnel will help check large-droplet models, with test analysis still underway. (source: https://www.nasa.gov/image-article/nasa-testing-aims-at-supercooled-large-droplet-aviation-safety/)

item.title: Репетиция Венеры в печи — зонд DAVINCI выдержал 465 °C / A furnace rehearsal for Venus — DAVINCI survives 465 °C

item.title: Научные итоги Crew-12 — что экипаж исследовал на МКС / Crew-12's science wrap-up — what the crew studied aboard the ISS

(source: https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/sep/29/anthropic-ipo-warning-existential-risks-to-humanity-from-ai-astrazeneca-2bn-cancer-drug-tie-up-diesel-stock-market-live-news-updates)
